method.cards: yellows + reds per match, both teams
method.projection: probability model (model.py): league x referee x team x opponent factors fitted together, negative binomial probabilities; settings tuned by `referees backtest`
method.england_second_yellow: football-data.co.uk: in English and Scottish files a second-yellow dismissal counts as 1 red only; in the other leagues it counts as 1 yellow + 1 red. Compare Premier League and Scottish numbers with care across leagues.
method.referee_sources: PL/PD/BL1/SA/FL1/PPL: football-data.org; SCO: the card file; GR/BEL: referee.observer history (from mid-2025).
